quote: Except as otherwise provided in an ordinance enacted pursuant to NRS 484A.469 [DEF-LVMC-11-40-185-A], an electric scooter may be operated: On a roadway, bicycle lane, path or route at a speed of not more than 15 miles per hour.

activation.condition: Electric scooter operation on a roadway, bicycle lane, path or route, subject to an applicable ordinance enacted under NRS 484A.469.

obligation.description: Operation on the listed facility at a speed of not more than 15 miles per hour.

exceptions.trigger: An applicable ordinance enacted pursuant to NRS 484A.469 provides otherwise.
exceptions.effect: Apply the source-proven ordinance provision to the affected operation.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Source-dependent; no replacement speed is inferred.
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in an ordinance enacted pursuant to NRS 484A.469 [DEF-LVMC-11-40-185-A]

timing.description: Assess speed during scooter operation on the listed facility.

parameter_refs.name: ego_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Observed scooter speed in mph from original Native velocity
